newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen up on Wednesday, helped by Dow.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen up on Wednesday, helped by Dow.

text.p: The Polish bourse was expected to rebound after a four-session fall, seen helped by the Dow Jones industrial average's surge on Tuesday.

But analysts said the subsequent market direction was unclear, with more falls possible after the central bank's decision last Friday to increase mandatory reserves on zloty term deposits from April 30, with banks especially vulnerable.

They said Celuloza, down seven percent on Monday and four percent on Tuesday after opening 4.9 percent above issue on Friday, could be helped by Tuesday's news it was exempted from 5.6 million zlotys in environment-related fines.

Analysts also said NFI units had more downward potential after the finance ministry's decision last Thursday to scrap in 1998 the corporate tax exemption NFIs enjoy on gains from selling firms in their portfolios.
The bourse is closed on Thursday and Friday.
